title: Connect to PostgreSQL
description: As a database designer, I want to connect to a PostgreSQL database by providing host, port, database, user, and password so that I can interact with a live database.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user enters connection details, when they attempt to connect, then the application tests the connection via the backend and indicates success or failure
And credentials are held only for the current session
resultEvidence: Implementation complete via child tasks TASK-036 (Connection Form UI), TASK-037 (Connection State Management), and backend dependency STORY-016 (test-connection endpoint).

Source files: src/connection/ConnectionForm.ts (host/port/database/user/password form), src/connection/connectionApi.ts (POST /api/v1/connections/test client), src/hooks/useConnection.ts (in-memory session credentials, status state machine), src/App.tsx (wiring + success/error banners), src/types.ts (ConnectionConfig, ConnectionResult types), backend/src/routes/test-connection.ts (testConnectionHandler at POST /api/v1/connections/test), backend/src/services/connection-test.service.ts (real pg.Client TCP+auth connection, bounded timeout, error categorization, password redaction).

Acceptance criteria verified: (1) User enters connection details → application tests via backend POST /api/v1/connections/test → success or failure indicated (ConnectionForm submits, useConnection tracks status, backend returns 200/400/401/502/504/500 with descriptive messages); (2) Credentials held only for current session (useConnection stores credentials in React state only, no localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB writes, cleared on disconnect() and component unmount, password redacted from all error messages).
